title: 30A Beach House Mira Bella Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Mira Bella, located in Inlet Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. PET FRIENDLY
description_expanded: Description Description 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Mira Bella, located in Inlet Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. PET FRIENDLY Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! This beautiful home has four bedrooms and plenty of room for everyone. An open, inviting living area and chef's kitchen add to its charm--not to mention the screened porch and comfortable coastal interiors. There's an outdoor grill and back patio for entertaining, and you're just a short ride from the beach! There is so much to see and do just minutes from this beach house in Inlet Beach, 30Avenue shopping and dining, Rosemary Beach and so much more. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * 30A Beach House - PET FRIENDLY * Spacious Front Porch with Rocking Chairs * 2 Bedroom Suites with En Suite Bathroom * Spacious Living Area with 65" TV * Back Porch - Seating for 8 * Kitchen - Breakfast Bar, Quartz Countertop, Farm Sink, Pantry * Dining Area * Bedroom 1 - King Bed, 65" Smart TV (Main Level) - En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - King Bed, 55" Smart TV (Upstairs) - En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 40" Smart TV * Bathroom 3 * Bedroom 4 - Bunk Room - 2 Bunk Beds (T/T, T/T) * Flex Living Area - Upstairs, 50" Smart TV, Full Sleeper * Half Bathroom on Main Level * Washer / Dryer * Grill in Backyard * Beach Gear - Owner Provided - 6 Beach Chairs, 2 Umbrellas, cooler, wagon, floats * Fabulous Community - 5 Minute walk from Back Porch to 30Avenue's Restaurants, shops, games and live music * FREE High Speed Wi-Fi 30A Public Beach Access Points Note: Surveillance device on exterior of home ABOUT THE PRESERVE AT INLET BEACH The Preserve at Inlet Beach in Inlet Beach, FL is a coastal community just a short bike ride to beach access. Guests will enjoy the community pool with pavilion and outdoor fireplace. The community wooden boardwalk & dock provides direct access to Lake Powell, providing quick and easy launching of paddleboards and kayaks. COMMUNITY AMENITIES COMMUNITY POOL PAVILION W/OUTDOOR FIREPLACE LAKE POWELL ACCESS - ENJOY PADDLEBOARDING & KAYAKING NATURE TRAILS EASY ACCESS TO DINING & SHOPPING SHORT BIKE RIDE TO BEACH ACCESS INLET BEACH Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome 1 well trained dog under 40 lbs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
